title: When the Hollow Sings
premise: Dominic Pemberton's gift for speaking with beasts is a death sentence in Thornfell, where the Wardens burn beast-speakers as heretics. When the border wards collapse and the stars vanish, Dominic discovers the wards were fed by an ancient pact with the mountain's hollow spirits — a pact broken by Warden High Command to fuel their war machines. Hunted by both smugglers who want his silence and Wardens who want his gift weaponized, Dominic must carry testimony from the last living hollow spirit to the neutral Conclave before the spirit dies and the mountains rise in vengeance. He succeeds at terrible cost: the truth is spoken, the war is averted, but Dominic loses his own memories of everyone he loved, paying the price of survival he always feared.
about_author: Tamsin Voss is the pen name of a former trail guide who spent six years leading expeditions through remote mountain passes, where she collected local legends of vanished stars and talking animals. She now writes fantasy from a cabin she insists is not haunted.

chapters.title: The Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Guiding a smuggler caravan through Thornfell, Dominic quietly negotiates with a mule about a washed-out bridge when every star above the peaks goes dark and the border wards shatter like glass. Emotional beat: dread — his hidden world and the world's hidden machinery breaking on the same night.

chapters.title: What the Mule Refused to Carry
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The mule refuses to enter a pass it calls 'the screaming place,' and Dominic follows its terror to a dying hollow spirit trapped beneath a collapsed ward-stone. It presses a fragment of memory into his mind: proof the Wardens broke the ancient pact. Emotional beat: reluctant burden accepted.

chapters.title: Ashes on the Toll Road
chapters.summary: Warden Captain Ilse Varga's POV. Investigating the fallen wards, Varga finds a village burned by panicked garrison troops and begins doubting the official story that smugglers caused the collapse. Emotional beat: loyalty cracking under evidence.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Price
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. His employer, smuggler-queen Renna Kade, learns what he carries and demands he sell it to the highest bidder; when he refuses, she marks him for death. He escapes into the high passes with only the mule and a wounded young Warden deserter, Tam. Emotional beat: betrayal by the only family he had.

chapters.title: Voices in the Stone
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. Tam discovers Dominic speaking with ravens and nearly reports him, then chooses silence after hearing the spirit's memory replayed through a raven's song. Emotional beat: complicity becoming trust.

chapters.title: The Hollow Remembers
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Sheltering in a ruined shrine, Dominic relives the spirit's full memory: the original pact, the first war, and the price the last beast-speaker paid to seal it — her memories of everyone she loved. Emotional beat: horror as he understands what carrying this truth will cost him.

chapters.title: Varga's Choice
chapters.summary: Varga's POV. Ordered to capture a suspected beast-speaker alive for weaponization, Varga instead burns her orders and defects, intercepting Renna's hunters to buy Dominic time. Emotional beat: justice chosen over law.

chapters.title: The Conclave Road
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The final ascent to the neutral Conclave becomes a running battle through starless night as Renna's smugglers and Warden loyalists converge. Tam takes a mortal wound holding the pass. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into resolve.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV (climax). Before the Conclave, the dying spirit speaks through Dominic, revealing the Wardens' crime to all factions at once. To complete the testimony and renew the pact, someone must pay the old price — and Dominic steps forward before anyone can stop him. Emotional beat: sacrifice freely given.

chapters.title: When the Hollow Sings
chapters.summary: Varga's POV. The stars return; the mountains quiet. Varga finds Dominic alive but blank-eyed, remembering nothing of Tam, Renna, or his own name's weight — yet the beasts still greet him gently, and the hollow sings when he passes. Emotional beat: bittersweet renewal; survival's price paid, and worth it.
